bio: Lloyd Puckitt marched as a member of The Cavaliers Drum and Bugle Corps (1983-1985) and studied Percussion Performance at the University of Louisiana at Lafayette. After a career as a recording engineer, he became a sound/audio designer and consultant in the marching arts, serving as Soundscape/Sound Designer for the Boston Crusaders (joining their design team in 2014-2015 and later named Audio Director in 2023). He is an Innovative Percussion, Evans, Planet Waves, and Dynasty Percussion artist, and has worked as a percussion educator in Illinois (Lake Park High School, Plainfield School District 202).

Joe Hobbs is a drum corps percussion arranger, caption head, and educator with over 20 years in the activity. He marched with Southwind (2001-2003, 2003 DCI I&E Snare Champion) and The Cavaliers (2004-2006), winning two DCI World Championships and earning the 2006 Cavalier of the Year and Zildjian awards. As an instructor he was Battery Instructor at Music City Mystique (2009-2011), Percussion Caption Head for The Cavaliers (2015-2018), a member of the Bluecoats percussion staff (2022 Fred Sanford Award; 2024 DCI World Champions), Battery Arranger for Music City Drum Corps (2023-2024), and is now Battery Arranger/Caption Head for Carolina Crown, with prior staff stints at Phantom Regiment and Spirit of Atlanta. He served as Director of Percussion at Vandegrift High School in Austin, TX, and is an Innovative Percussion / Tapspace artist.

Katie Hopkins is a dancer, teacher, and choreographer based in Austin, Texas, who serves as Movement & Choreography Caption Manager for Santa Clara Vanguard (2018-present). She marched in The Cadets color guard (2006-2009) and went on to teach and choreograph for The Cadets (2010-2017), and in 2023 worked as a choreographer for Carolina Crown and Phantom Regiment. She directs the Vandegrift High School Vision Dance Company (2019-present) and choreographs for WGI independent world guard programs, and holds a B.A. in Dance from Columbia College Chicago.

Rick Subel is a pageantry/color guard designer and choreographer with over 30 years of experience. He began marching as a baritone player for the 1992 Cadets of Bergen County, later performing with Blue Devils and the Emerald Marquis Winter Guard while studying at Berklee College of Music. He has designed and choreographed color guard for numerous drum corps including The Cadets, Crossmen, Santa Clara Vanguard, Bluecoats, Magic of Orlando, and Phantom Regiment (color guard designer/caption head), and served as Artistic Coordinator for Carolina Crown (2016-2023). He is co-founder and co-director of Paramount Winterguard in Atlanta.

Austin Greene is a professional visual designer, educator, and adjudicator from Raleigh, NC. He instructed The Cadets (2012-2015, Visual Caption Head 2014-2015), served as Assistant Caption Head/Manager for The Cavaliers (2023), Education Director for the Blue Knights, and is on the instructional staff of the Bluecoats. He holds a B.S. in Music Education from Western Carolina University and an M.M. in Conducting from the University of Connecticut, and previously taught at Concord High School and Durham School of the Arts. He adjudicates for Bands of America, WGI, and DCI.

Matt Hartwell is a full-time visual designer and educator based in Long Beach, CA, currently serving as Visual Caption Head for Phantom Regiment (since 2022/2023) and Visual Caption Manager for Pulse Percussion (since 2017). He marched baritone and tuba with The Cavaliers (2005-2008, including a DCI World Championship) after Capital Regiment (2004). He taught Santa Clara Vanguard (2010-2021, Visual Caption Manager from 2017) and worked with both Blue Devils and Bluecoats in summer 2022.

Chris Cook is a color guard choreographer and creative designer in the marching arts. He is listed as a guard choreographer for Carolina Crown and has worked on color guard/visual staff for the Crossmen, and served as Creative Designer for Genesis (2023). His broader credits include work with Phantom Regiment and choreography/performance for the Super Bowl LI halftime show.

Ezekiel Lanser is a percussion arranger, composer, and educator who serves as Battery Percussion Arranger/Composer for Pacific Crest. He earned a B.M. in Percussion Performance from the University of North Texas, marched with the Seattle Cascades, Esperanza, and Phantom Regiment (2006-2007), and has been on percussion staff with Boston Crusaders, Phantom Regiment, and Santa Clara Vanguard (snare tech, 3 years). He is the percussion caption head at Pacifica High School and is on design/music staff at Los Alamitos High School and Pulse Percussion.

Michael Rosales is a choreographer and movement specialist in the marching arts. Born in Manila, Philippines, he moved to San Francisco at age 9 and trained in ballet, jazz, modern, hip-hop, Latin jazz and color guard. A former member of the Concord Blue Devils, Fantasia of Riverside and San Jose Raiders, he has provided movement/choreography for drum corps including The Carolina Crown, Bluecoats, Cadets Color Guard and Santa Clara Vanguard, where he is the Lead Choreographer. He is also Creative Director of The Breakdown Camp, and his broader performance career includes the production BLAST!, the film RENT, and work with recording artists such as Ricky Martin and Luis Fonsi.
